description: Let's get your Discord bot up and running — follow the steps below

guild.copyServerIdHint: Right-click your Discord server name → Copy Server ID
guild.adminRoleHint: Full access — can use all commands

reset.confirmDescription: This clears the saved bot token, guild and channel IDs, role IDs, chat relay settings, command permissions, and Discord event notification setup. The bot will stop and the page will return to first-time setup.
reset.managementHint: Moving the bot to a new Discord server? Use wipe to remove the stored Discord setup and restart the wizard cleanly.

wizard.createApplicationDescription: First, you need to create an application on Discord's Developer Portal. This only takes a minute.
wizard.openDeveloperPortalDescription: Click the button below to open it in a new tab.
wizard.newApplicationDescription: It's in the top-right corner. Name it anything you like (e.g. "PZ Server Bot").
wizard.botSectionDescription: In the left sidebar of your new application, click Bot. Discord may auto-create a bot user, or you may see an Add Bot button — click it if so.
wizard.botWhyDescription: A Discord bot lets your panel send messages, register slash commands, and bridge in-game chat to a Discord channel. It runs through this panel, so you do not need separate hosting.
wizard.copyBotTokenDescription: On the Bot page in the Developer Portal, click "Reset Token" (or "Copy" if visible), then paste it below.
wizard.tokenWarning: Discord only shows the token once after you reset it. If you lose it, you will need to generate a new one. Treat it like a password and never share it publicly.
wizard.enableIntentsDescription: Still on the Bot page in the Developer Portal, scroll down to "Privileged Gateway Intents" and enable these:
wizard.serverMembersIntentWhy: Required to check user roles for admin commands
wizard.messageContentIntentWhy: Required for two-way chat bridge (Discord ↔ Game)
wizard.saveIntentsDescription: After toggling the intents on, scroll down and click the Save Changes button on the Discord page.
wizard.inviteBotTitle: Invite the Bot to Your Discord Server
wizard.inviteReadyDescription: Click the button below to invite your bot. Select your Discord server from the dropdown, then click "Authorize".
wizard.inviteManualDescription: We need your bot token to generate an invite link. Go back to Step 2 and paste + verify your token first, or use the manual method below.
wizard.permissionsList: Send Messages, Embed Links, Read Message History, Use Slash Commands
wizard.manualInviteDescription: If you have not verified your token yet, you can still invite the bot manually.
wizard.manualStep1: In the Developer Portal, go to your app → OAuth2 → URL Generator
wizard.manualStep3: Under "Bot Permissions", check Send Messages, Embed Links, Read Message History, and Use Slash Commands
wizard.manualStep4: Copy the generated URL at the bottom and open it in your browser
wizard.manualStep5: Select your Discord server and click Authorize
wizard.inviteTip: Tip: go back to Step 2 and verify your token — we'll generate the invite link automatically.
wizard.configureServerIdsDescription: The bot needs your Discord server's ID to register slash commands. You can also set a notification channel and an admin role.
wizard.developerStep1: Open Discord → User Settings (gear icon, bottom-left)
wizard.developerModeDescription: Now you can right-click servers, channels, and roles to see a "Copy ID" option.
wizard.copyServerIdInstruction: Right-click your Discord server name → Copy Server ID
wizard.copyChannelIdInstruction: Right-click a text channel → Copy Channel ID. Used for notifications and two-way chat bridge.
wizard.copyRoleIdInstruction: Right-click a role → Copy Role ID. Only users with this role can use bot commands. Leave blank to allow everyone.
wizard.readyToLaunchDescription: Review your configuration below, then save and start the bot.
wizard.autoStartDescription: Automatically start the Discord bot when the panel launches
wizard.slashCommandsDescription: Control your PZ server from Discord with /status, /players, /start, /stop, /restart, /broadcast, /kick, and /rcon.
wizard.chatBridgeDescription: Keep Discord and in-game chat in the same loop without switching tools during live admin work.
wizard.eventNotificationsDescription: Send join/leave, start/stop, restart, death, and backup events straight to the channel your admins already watch.

management.statusDescription: Notifications, slash commands, and the chat bridge all depend on the bot staying connected to the configured channel.
management.commandPermissionsDescription: Control who can use each slash command. Assign a permission tier per command.
management.autoStartDescription: The bot will start automatically when the panel boots up
management.chatRelayDescription: Forward player chat messages from the game server to Discord

events.title: Event Notifications
events.description: Automatic notifications posted to your Discord channel when server events occur
